title: McLaren F1 vs McLaren W1: The Real Difference
description:
Thirty-two years separate the McLaren F one and the McLaren W one. The W one has about twice the horsepower, goes from zero to sixty in two point seven seconds, and costs several times more. And yet there is one important number where the old car still wins. Today we compare the two, line by line, and explain the difference that nobody explains. Here is the hint. McLaren itself calls the new W one the fastest-accelerating road-legal car it has ever built. But the F one has a top speed record that the W one does not even try to match. So which one is really the better car? The honest answer depends on what you mean by better.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
